body:
Let's be clear: there is no better crystal for manifesting realities, programming intentions, or amplifying energies than tumbled Quartz. It's a bold statement, but this is a bold crystal. We like to think of Clear Quartz tumbled stone as the ultimate rockstar. In the crystal world, keeping up with tumbled Quartz can be like keeping up with the Jones'—it's hard to match up to a crystal as universally powerful as tumbled Clear Quartz. While this crystal has enjoyed mystical notoriety since the days of ancient Greece, today it's even used in technology to hold currents of energy. This is how we know tumbled Clear Quartz is so amazing at programming.

Once you program or set your intention for your Clear Quartz stone, it will constantly put your intention out into the universe even when you are not thinking about it. Clear Quartz healing properties will also raise and amplify the energy level of any other crystals that come into contact with it. This is why we put Clear Quartz at the end of many Energy Muse pieces and also recommend that you charge your jewelry by placing them on Quartz crystals. This stone is also essential in crystal grids. If you want to elevate the energy of the other crystals in the grid and program them to maintain the intention you set, always add a tumbled Quartz stone to the healing layout.

A tumbled Clear Quartz stone also brings clarity to the mind, helping you focus and become clear on your dreams and desires. They assist with spiritual development and removing energy blockages that occur in the body. Clear Quartz connects to every chakra, purifying and re-energizing your chakras so that your mind, core, and base are all working in harmony at the highest potential. When you are working with other crystals and their meanings, try adding tumbled Clear Quartz into your combination; it will amplify the energies and magnify your intention.

Get crystal clear with the help of Clear Quartz. If you're facing a tough decision or fork in the road, work with the stone to illuminate and understand your true path. Its chakra-cleansing powers are also helpful in aligning your head with your heart, allowing you to move forward with full confidence in any situation.

Because of its natural quality, each Clear Quartz Tumbled stone will vary slightly in size, shape, color, and pattern. Each comes with a card or PDF crystal sheet that holds information about the crystal and its meaning.
